integrity: The argument extracts a finite-cardinality consequence from the primary paper's explicit lower-bound construction before the final passage to the infinite lacunary supremum. The test has exact L1 norm one; the source finite modulation block has cardinality comparable to N squared; and its Bohr-set level estimate yields weak-L1 size comparable to log N. Reparameterizing N by the requested cardinality M and padding the dyadic block proves the stated logarithmic entropy lower bound.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a worst-case logarithmic lower bound for finite consecutive dyadic modulation blocks. It does not determine the optimal finite-family growth, does not apply to every finite modulation set, and does not claim an analogous law for general polynomial phases.
title: Logarithmic entropy obstruction for finite quadratic Carleson modulation sets
